note: The Squire's arming sword, tier III (elite), painted at 3 texels per model px on a 96 x 192 sheet (the texel-3 trial; the 2x twin is commit c83a5e8): a broad polished fullered blade with a continuous gilt thread in its groove, a 3 x 3.5 px steel boss on the grip with the Order's sun painted on it (9 texels across) and a short gilt ray each side, a straight cross with one engraved groove and gilt diamond terminals, an enamel-wound grip and a 2.7 px sun pommel in a gilt star; 24.1 px long.
